cards.subject: A forest, restored
lines: Naralex learned the Barrens had been lush before the Sundering, and went underground to put it back.
The plan was to link the water down here to the Emerald Dream through his own body. This dungeon exists because somebody tried to fix the zone above it.

cards.subject: The cave before the portal
lines: The outdoor cave is its own place: deviate raptors, wind serpents and oozes, and two questgivers.
Mad Magglish is in there too, stealthed.
Most players walk past him for years.

cards.subject: Read the minimap on the way down
cards.tag: The place names are the plot
lines: Cavern of Mists. Winding Chasm. Screaming Gully. Pit of Fangs. Crag of the Everliving.
And at the bottom, Dreamer's Rock.
The map is telling you the story in order, and nobody reads it.

cards.subject: Deviate Fish
lines: Eaten raw they do one random thing: heal you, shrink you, put you to sleep for thirty seconds, or make you dance uncontrollably for two minutes.
Cooked into Savory Deviate Delight they turn you into a pirate or a black-clad ninja for a full hour.

cards.subject: Kresh
lines: The turtles down here were never affected by any of it.
Kresh is an ancient tortoise wandering the river near the start, living his life normally.
Everything else in this cave is a deviate. He just did not catch it.

cards.subject: The Druids of the Fang
lines: Not a rival order. They went in with Naralex, and went insane when the Nightmare came through his body.
Lord Serpentis was his finest student.
You kill four of them to reach the man they followed.

cards.subject: The lock on the last room
lines: Nothing at the end begins until all four Fanglords are dead. Muyoh will not start the ritual before that.
Kresh, Skum and Verdan are optional and can be skipped entirely.

cards.subject: Verdan the Everliving
lines: A bog beast formed long ago out of the lush foliage of this place, and its original protector.
The nightmare twisted him into something that crushes whatever comes near.
He is what the caverns looked like healthy — still alive, still on duty, ruined.

cards.subject: The wailing is steam
lines: The cry comes from steam bursting out of fissures and wind moving through the tunnels.
Naralex named the caverns that before he ever went in.
They were already crying while they were still healthy. The Nightmare did not make the sound.

cards.subject: The end is not a boss room
lines: A tauren druid walks to the chamber and enters the Emerald Dream to pull Naralex out: "Protect me brave souls as I delve into the Emerald Dream."
Waves come while he works. You stand still and hold the room.
Then: "I AM AWAKE, AT LAST!"

cards.subject: Mutanus the Devourer
lines: He is not a cave native. He is a manifestation out of Naralex's own corrupted sleep, sent to stop anyone waking him.
The last thing in the dungeon is the sleeping man's worst fear, standing up and walking out of him.

cards.subject: Nobody walks out with you
lines: Naralex and Muyoh do not leave the way you came.
They take flight and go, and you are standing at Dreamer's Rock on your own.
